$comment: Index of custom WebMCP tools. Update this file whenever you add or change a tool. One entry per tool. namespace must equal the domain. status: draft | qa_passed | verified | broken. Entry fields: domain, tool, file (path under domains/), kind, url_patterns, status, qa_agent (agent id of the independent QA pass, or null), browser_session (live Kernel session id, or null when expired), last_verified (ISO date), notes.

tools.notes: Independent QA checked 60 flight options across six populated searches, plus no-results, invalid-input and offline cases. Domain-namespace migration verified live from /content/travel-info: SEA-SFO round trip returned 10 of 45 options. Adults only; outbound first page; displayed fares per adult, including round-trip starting fares rather than selected return flights. See domain README for limitations.
